Collection/Verde Alpi
N° 03 / 08

verde alpi

[ 01 ] — Character

Alpine green: dark serpentine, held in a net of pale veins.

Verde Alpi is quarried in the Aosta Valley, in the Italian Alps. It is a serpentine marble: angular green fragments bound together by veins of white and pale-green calcite. Dark, dense and full of movement, it has long been used for columns, floors and inlay.

Origin
Aosta Valley, Italy
Stone
Serpentine marble
Ground
Deep green, mottled
Veining
A net of white and pale green
Finishes
Polished, honed, brushed, bush-hammered
Formats
Slabs, tiles, cut-to-size

[ 04 ] — Laying it out

Open the block like a book.
